provenance.what: Every non-null `party` value served by the schema-4 API snapshot: ec_pv rows as [year, state_usps, candidate_slug, party] and national_rollup rows as [year, candidate_slug, party]. The AC3 oracle for #386: schema 5 must serve these values unchanged, and null on every other row.
provenance.source: MIT Election Lab (party values, CC0-1.0); keys from U.S. National Archives data (public domain). The schema-4 snapshot is redistributable-only (D030), so it holds no UCSB value.
provenance.lifetime: Pinned to the MIT load behind that snapshot. A deliberate MIT refresh regenerates this file from the then-live snapshot; a mismatch is never fixed by editing it.
